app.title: OA Risk Screening
disclaimer.not_a_diagnosis: This is a preliminary screening assessment and is NOT a medical diagnosis. Confirmation requires examination by a qualified clinician.
guidance.activity: Walk on level ground and do gentle thigh-strengthening exercises daily.
guidance.avoid_squat: Avoid deep squatting and sitting cross-legged for long periods.
guidance.nutrition: Eat a balanced diet with adequate protein, calcium and vitamin D.
guidance.slope_load: Break up long slope or stair climbs and reduce carried loads.
guidance.warmth: Gentle warmth and slow movement help morning stiffness.
guidance.weight: Reducing body weight lowers the load on the knees.
rec.refer_phc: Review at the PHC within 4 weeks
rec.refer_specialist: Refer to an orthopaedic specialist or district hospital
rec.urgent_swelling: Joint swelling present - clinical review sooner
report.disagreement: ! rule engine and model disagree - the higher band is shown
report.model_escalated: ! model raised the risk band by one level
report.title: OA SCREENING REPORT
